description: BW-only diagnostic matrix for the continuous-LoRa Sobel example. Two orthogonal axes: class-BW vs GT BW (augmentation/alias axis, split by scaling direction) and measured BW vs GT BW (bounding-box height quality axis). No SF conditions: SF misclassification is delegated to mAP metrics. Cells are mutually exclusive and exhaustive.

hypotheses.name: class_sf
hypotheses.label: Nominal class SF (detected vs GT SF)

hypotheses.name: class_bw
hypotheses.label: Nominal class BW (detected vs GT BW)

hypotheses.name: measured_bw
hypotheses.label: Measured BW (box estimate vs GT BW)

class_axis.class_ok: abs(col('Class BW') - col('GT BW')) / col('GT BW') <= 0.10

measured_axis.measured_ok: abs(col('Measured BW') - col('GT BW')) / col('GT BW') <= 0.10
measured_axis.measured_off: abs(col('Measured BW') - col('GT BW')) / col('GT BW') > 0.10
